title: Border Patrol agents rush to help injured driver after highway rollover in Laredo
excerpt: A vehicle rolled over on a highway in Laredo, leaving the driver injured. U.S. Border Patrol agents from the Laredo Sector were among the first to help, assisting local law enforcement and emergency responders at the scene.
content:
A vehicle rollover was reported on a highway in Laredo, leaving the driver injured.

U.S. Border Patrol agents assigned to the Laredo Sector responded to the scene, assisting local law enforcement after the rollover. Agents provided immediate assistance to the injured driver while coordinating with emergency responders.

Photos from the scene show a dark-colored SUV off the road in tall grass at night, with its airbags deployed and heavy damage to the roof and front end.

The highway where the rollover happened was not named, and no further details about the driver — including the driver’s identity or condition beyond being injured — had been released as of Monday.

Source: U.S. Border Patrol, Laredo Sector, Nov. 23, 2026.
